title: Entitled Ex-Cop's Daughter Resists Arrest, Calls Dad & Gets Window Smashed!
description:
On November 3rd, 2023, an officer was on patrol in Ohio when he observed a red Ford Explorer making an illegal right turn, causing the officer to brake harshly. Upon initiating a traffic of the vehicle, the female driver told the officer she did not have her driver’s license on her. After verifying the driver’s identity, the officer noted an odor of marijuana coming from the vehicle. 

The situation escalated when the driver refused to comply with instructions or agree to a vehicle search. The officer called for backup as the driver took out a camcorder and recorded the traffic stop. Despite repeated commands to exit the vehicle, the driver remained non-compliant, refusing to exit the vehicle, leading officers to break the driver's side window. The suspect was placed under arrest and escorted to a patrol car. 

After securing the suspect and conducting a vehicle search, which yielded suspected marijuana and open bottles of whiskey. The suspect was charged with Obstructing Official Business and Open Container and a traffic citation for the illegal right turn.
